Gaolan.why: Builds data-center liquid-cooling systems (cold-plate and immersion CDUs, piping / manifolds, cold plates, immersion tanks); AI computing liquid-cooling projects drove its H1 2026 growth, so AI data-center build-out directly lifts its revenue.
Gaolan.evidence: Gaolan half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-22-2026): high-power-density device thermal management = data-center liquid-cooling products incl. cold-plate and immersion solutions (room CDUs, piping and manifolds); revenue rose as AI computing-center liquid-cooling projects landed in volume; segment revenue RMB 210,110,127.68, up 53.41%.

players.product: Data-center liquid-cooling systems on the facility side (cold-plate and immersion: CDUs, secondary-side piping and manifolds, server cold plates, fluid connectors, immersion tanks; pump-driven two-phase cold-plate system in development) for leading internet companies and IDC operators, alongside HVDC converter-valve and energy-storage liquid cooling

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 results (annual report): revenue RMB 989,123,831.32, up 43.09%; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 28,383,086.38, up 156.40% (2024: RMB -50,322,088.12); net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 55,781,819.77, up 194.43%; operating cash flow RMB 110,855,883.75. Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 218,000,373.52, Q2 RMB 199,747,553.96, Q3 RMB 170,030,185.72, Q4 RMB 401,345,718.12; Q4 net profit RMB -5,851,873.66. Because the company now intends to sell its stake in the associate Dongguan Guixiang, it recognized a deferred tax liability of RMB 3,649.35 ten-thousand. The company says revenue and orders in hand both grew substantially and core-business revenue and gross margin rose; overall gross margin 28.94% (up 4.91 points).

Segments, FY2025 (annual report): high-power power-electronics thermal management products RMB 573,069,708.36, 57.94% of revenue, up 161.75%, gross margin 35.04%; high-power-density device thermal management products (data-center and energy-storage liquid cooling) RMB 264,343,986.52, 26.73% of revenue, down 19.44%, gross margin 13.10% (up 3.98 points); engineering O&M services RMB 114,571,196.33, up 9.09%. Overseas revenue RMB 8,998,598.88, up 239.47%. Sales volume 1,134.16 sets and output 1,144.94 sets (converted at standard cooling capacity), down 37.79% and 31.26%, which the company attributes to mix: mainly high-capacity DC water-cooling products in 2025 versus more lower-capacity energy-storage liquid cooling in 2024.
quarterly_data.figure: High-power-density thermal RMB 264,343,986.52 (-19.44%), gross margin 13.10%; power-electronics thermal RMB 573,069,708.36 (+161.75%)

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 business review (annual report): in data-center thermal management the company completed its cold-plate and immersion technology routes, its container computing-center liquid-cooling products strengthened, and it delivered a national key AIDC project in Shenzhen; its full series of liquid-cooling CDU products reached scaled commercial use. International business grew more than 200% in 2025: it won a large Saudi DC transmission order, landed flagship projects in Thailand and Malaysia and won its first overseas data-center liquid-cooling EPC project; it set up subsidiaries in the USA and Singapore. The data-center thermal subsidiary Guangzhou Gaolan Innovation Technology had 2025 revenue RMB 268,708,046.95 and net profit RMB 153,172.79. Contract liabilities rose to RMB 346,963,738.47 from RMB 117,622,119.83 on project advance payments, and inventory rose on stocking for orders in hand.
quarterly_data.figure: International business +200%+; data-center subsidiary 2025 revenue RMB 268,708,046.95

quarterly_data.signal: R&D (annual report): R&D investment RMB 54,388,268.98 in 2025, 5.50% of revenue (6.54% in 2024), 178 R&D staff. Data-center projects include a pump-driven two-phase cold-plate liquid-cooling system and a 600kW high-efficiency liquid-cooling system (both: prototype built, engineering prototype being optimized, at the promotion and application stage), a low-energy immersion liquid-cooling system and coolant purification technology (promotion and application stage), plus a coolant formulation for data-center copper cold plates and an AI application architecture for data-center liquid cooling (in development).
quarterly_data.figure: R&D RMB 54,388,268.98, 5.50% of revenue; 600kW liquid-cooling system and two-phase cold-plate system at engineering-prototype stage

quarterly_data.signal: 2026 business plan (annual report, company plan, not a forecast): in data-center thermal management the company plans to consolidate its relationships with leading domestic customers, replicate its overseas flagship projects, focus on AI computing markets in China, Southeast Asia, North America and the Middle East, iterate high-compute liquid-cooling solutions and optimize supply chain and cost to grow gross profit; in power thermal management it aims to hold its HVDC lead and its offshore flexible-DC position; overseas it will build on the Saudi flexible-DC valve-cooling and Thailand data-center liquid-cooling EPC projects with localized teams; and it will optimize scheduling and make production lines smarter to secure core capacity for domestic and overseas orders.
